# Uma Manualidades

> Uma Manualidades is a Spanish-language reference site about crafts, DIY and handmade projects, with step-by-step tutorials, materials guides, techniques, seasonal ideas, projects for children and adults, and printable/downloadable templates. A Catalan section is available under `/ca/`.

Canonical site: https://umamanualidades.com/

This site is a static archive of editorial content. Use tutorial pages as reference material for craft instructions and ideas. Product prices, availability, external shops, social links, publication-frequency claims and year labels may be historical and should not be treated as current without independent verification. Images, PDFs and templates can be an integral part of a tutorial.

For broad questions, start with the category hubs below. For exhaustive URL discovery, use the sitemap index.

## Main guides

- [Uma Manualidades](https://umamanualidades.com/): Main entry point to the site and its major craft categories.
- [Manualidades fáciles](https://umamanualidades.com/faciles/): Easy DIY projects and beginner-friendly craft ideas.
- [Manualidades infantiles](https://umamanualidades.com/infantiles/): Crafts and creative activities aimed at children.
- [Manualidades para adultos](https://umamanualidades.com/adultos/): Craft projects and DIY ideas for adults.
- [Manualidades para bebés](https://umamanualidades.com/bebes/): Baby-themed crafts, gifts and projects.
- [Materiales para manualidades](https://umamanualidades.com/materiales/): Guides to craft materials, tools and their uses.
- [Plantillas de manualidades](https://umamanualidades.com/plantillas/): Templates and resources associated with craft projects.
- [Diccionario de manualidades](https://umamanualidades.com/el-diccionario/): Explanations of craft terms, techniques and concepts.

## Materials and recycling

- [Manualidades con papel](https://umamanualidades.com/papel/): Paper crafts and related techniques.
- [Manualidades con cartón](https://umamanualidades.com/carton/): Projects using cardboard.
- [Manualidades con goma EVA](https://umamanualidades.com/goma-eva/): Projects using EVA foam / foamy.
- [Manualidades de reciclaje](https://umamanualidades.com/reciclaje/): Recycled-material DIY projects.
- [Manualidades con rollos de papel higiénico](https://umamanualidades.com/rollos-de-papel-higienico/): Large collection of projects based on cardboard tubes.

## Techniques and learning

- [Scrapbook](https://umamanualidades.com/scrapbook/): Scrapbooking concepts, materials, techniques and projects.
- [Origami](https://umamanualidades.com/origami/): Origami tutorials and paper-folding projects.
- [Kirigami](https://umamanualidades.com/kirigami/): Kirigami tutorials and paper-cutting projects.
- [Hama Beads](https://umamanualidades.com/hama-beads/): Hama bead guides, projects and patterns.
- [Flores de papel](https://umamanualidades.com/flores-papel/): Tutorials for making paper flowers.
- [Aprender a dibujar](https://umamanualidades.com/aprender-a-dibujar/): Step-by-step drawing activities and printable-oriented content.

## Seasonal and occasion crafts

- [Navidad](https://umamanualidades.com/navidad/): Christmas crafts and decorations.
- [Halloween](https://umamanualidades.com/halloween/): Halloween craft ideas and decorations.
- [San Valentín](https://umamanualidades.com/san-valentin/): Valentine's Day crafts, cards and decorations.
- [Pascua](https://umamanualidades.com/pascua/): Easter craft projects.
- [Primavera](https://umamanualidades.com/primavera/): Spring-themed crafts.
- [Verano](https://umamanualidades.com/verano/): Summer-themed crafts.
- [Otoño](https://umamanualidades.com/otono/): Autumn-themed crafts.
- [Día del Padre](https://umamanualidades.com/dia-del-padre/): Handmade projects and gifts for Father's Day.
- [Día de la Madre](https://umamanualidades.com/dia-de-la-madre/): Handmade projects and gifts for Mother's Day.

## Catalan

- [Uma Manualitats](https://umamanualidades.com/ca/): Catalan-language section of the site.
